sink.description: String concatenation into SQL query passed to Db.exec

flow.description: User input read from query parameter
Passed to Db.exec as raw SQL

findings.description: User-controlled input from HTTP query parameter is concatenated directly into a SQL query string without parameterization.
findings.suggested_fix: Use Caqti prepared statements with typed parameters instead of string concatenation.

notes: Single injection path identified. No parameterization or escaping observed.
